name: Real estate showing requests
description: Listing questions from the knowledge base, showings for buyers without an agent, and messages for buyers' agents and sellers.

nodes.name: Find out why they're calling
nodes.prompt: Find out whether the caller wants to see a listing, has a question about one, wants to sell, or is another agent. If they already said it, move on right away.

when.intent: has a question about a listing, like price, size, HOA fees or schools
wants to sell a home or get a home valued
is a real estate agent calling for a client
is a telemarketer, robocall or sales pitch

nodes.name: Listing questions
nodes.prompt: Answer questions about the team's listings from the knowledge base: price, size, features, HOA fees, open houses and status. If a listing isn't in the knowledge base or its status may have changed, say an agent will confirm. Never comment on schools' quality, neighborhood safety or who lives in an area; offer the public sources instead.

nodes.name: Showing details
nodes.prompt: Get the details for the showing. Ask one thing at a time and read the address back.

nodes.name: Book the showing
nodes.prompt: Book a showing at {{fields.listing_address}}. Offer two open times from availability, such as the soonest, or ones near a day the caller already mentioned. If neither works, ask what day or time of day suits them and offer the closest open times. As soon as the caller picks one, book it; don't ask them to confirm first.

nodes.name: Confirm the showing
nodes.prompt: The showing is booked. Confirm the address, day and time in one short sentence, and say the agent will meet them there and may text before the showing. Ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Message for the listing agent
nodes.prompt: Showings for buyers who have an agent are set up agent to agent. Take a message for the listing agent with the address and the buyer's agent's name and brokerage. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first.

nodes.name: Seller details
nodes.prompt: Get the basics so an agent can prepare before calling back.

nodes.name: Message for a listing agent
nodes.prompt: Take a message for a listing agent about selling {{fields.property_address}}. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Never estimate what the home is worth.

nodes.name: Take a message
nodes.prompt: Take a message for the team. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first.

nodes.name: Wrap up the message
nodes.prompt: The message is saved. Tell the caller an agent will call back and ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Decline politely
nodes.message: Politely say the business isn't interested, without sharing any business details.

fields.label: Listing address
fields.description: Address or MLS number of the listing they want to see.

fields.label: Has a buyer's agent
fields.description: Whether the caller is already working with a real estate agent.

fields.label: Financing
fields.description: Where they are with financing, if they want to say.

fields.label: Property address
fields.description: Address of the home they want to sell.

fields.label: How they heard about us
fields.description: Sign, website, referral or other source, if mentioned.
